basic_profile.bio: I'm a 25-year-old software developer from Toronto who recently discovered Reddit. I enjoy playing hockey and often find myself exploring different topics late at night. I have a keen interest in technology and self-improvement. Currently single, I spend my downtime learning new programming languages and indulging in some guilty pleasure browsing on subreddits like Embarrassing_Moments. I usually hop online after work, around 7 PM.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Computer Science and work as a software developer. Most of my knowledge comes from formal education and hands-on experience in the tech industry. I'm also learning about Azure DevOps through online courses and practice.
